issues.description: Removing 'category__in' from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES regresses the active-filter badge for the new findings Category filter.
issues.detail: The PR adds a Category filter to findings but simultaneously deletes the category__in entry from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES in active-filter-badge.tsx. With no replacement registered, applied categories will no longer surface as removable badge chips, contradicting the PR's Active Filter Badges goal and breaking parity with other filters.

issues.description: Heuristic getCategoryLabel mislabels short non-acronym words and regresses curated labels like 'Trust Boundaries'.
issues.detail: formatWord uppercases any word with length <= 3, so words like 'new', 'web', 'app', 'key' render as 'NEW', 'WEB'. SPECIAL_CASES is empty, so 'trustboundaries' becomes 'Trustboundaries' instead of the previously curated 'Trust Boundaries'. Restore explicit mappings for known multi-word IDs.

issues.description: labelFormatter passed into getBadgeLabel risks desync between display label and raw filter value.
issues.detail: data-table-filter-custom.tsx now passes the human-readable displayLabel into getBadgeLabel(entity, displayLabel). If downstream code uses that string as an identifier for selection, removal, or URL query construction, the formatted 'IAM' could collide with the raw value 'iam' and break filter round-tripping or chip dismissal.

issues.description: Duplicate SEVERITY_ORDER entries for 'Informational' and 'Info' both mapping to 4 invite non-deterministic ordering.
issues.detail: Adding Info: 4 alongside Informational: 4 creates two keys with the same rank. Reverse lookups, legend rendering, or grouping that assumes uniqueness will treat them ambiguously when both forms appear. Normalize incoming values to a single canonical label at the API boundary instead of aliasing in the order map.

issues.description: CategorySelector handles an empty-string value that the underlying Select never emits.
issues.detail: handleValueChange treats value === '' as clearing selection, but Radix Select disallows empty SelectItem values and only 'all' or a category id can be emitted. The empty-string branch and the unreachable SelectValue placeholder are dead code; simplify to just check for 'all'.

issues.description: HorizontalBarChart recomputes maxValue inside the .map callback for every row.
issues.detail: Math.max(...data.map(d => d.value)) is evaluated for each iteration of the outer map, making it O(n^2). Hoist the computation above the map for clarity and to avoid wasted work as the dataset grows. Functionally correct but worth a small refactor.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a single verdict: the PR cleanly extracts category labeling and adds a Risk Radar plus findings Category filter, but introduces several UX and correctness regressions worth fixing before merge. The strongest consensus issues are the removal of the category__in entry from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES (regressing active-filter chips), the new heuristic getCategoryLabel that loses curated labels like 'Trust Boundaries' and mis-uppercases short words, and the labelFormatter-into-badgeLabel wiring that risks desyncing display strings from raw filter values. Duplicate Informational/Info entries in SEVERITY_ORDER should be normalized upstream. Minor cleanups: dead empty-string branch in CategorySelector and an O(n^2) maxValue computation in HorizontalBarChart.
